bayts.text: I praise my Nurturer, the Guardian (Al-Wakīl), invoking blessings upon my imām, the guarantor,
our Prophet, our Messenger, the beloved, our intercessor, our leader, the one who answers,
His intimate, the effacer of lies, Muḥammad, our hope, together, here as tomorrow,
and his Family, his Companions and the Followers. And then: You are the One sought, O Helper (Al-Muʿīn).
Forgive me, forgive my parents and everyone, and accept our deeds.
Make easy for us all that benefits us, and spare us all that harms us.
Make easy for us all that has become hard, by grace, and subject to me the whole of creation.
O Benign (Al-Barr), O Watchful (Ar-Raqīb), O Reckoner (Al-Ḥasīb), O Just (Al-ʿAdl), O Majestic (Al-Jalīl), O Answerer (Al-Mujīb),
You are my Patron here and then tomorrow: You are my hope, so be mine for ever.
To You my prayer, for ever, and my rite; to You my life and my death (Qurʾān 6:162), O my King.
To You my heart and my tongue, O Majestic; to You what is before me and what is behind me, O Beautiful (Al-Jamīl).
You are the halting-place of the caravan of my needs, O Generous (Al-Karīm); You are the end of my complaints, O All-Knowing (Al-ʿAlīm).
Prepare for me, always, right conduct in my affair (Qurʾān 18:10), and be my Patron and my Helper for ever.
You are the One to Whom belong the lofty heavens, the earths and all that has appeared in them.
Yours, my God, are the dominion and the praise together; You give life and give death, Originator from nothing.
Everything has been humbled before Your might, O Master Who subdues every living being.
O Possessor of Majesty and Generosity, O Spreader of provisions for bestowing favour,
we are suppliants (seeking favours): forgive at every time, at Your door, which is the halting-place of those who prosper.
Provide us all, my God, with the best provision, and choose for us, by Your grace, the best of desires.
Increase me in knowledge, God-fearing piety and courtesy, until I become a wonder for creation.
Make my heart pliant toward acts of obedience, and subject to me all the transgressors.
It is You Who made me beloved to creation, until they deem me a man of worth and a bulwark,
yet I am certain that I have nothing but Your veil (covering my faults), by Your grace.
Be with me for ever and do not leave me to other than You, but take charge of my state Yourself.
I have turned to You in repentance, O Forgiving (Al-Ghafūr), and I take refuge in You from Satan, Lord, and seek shelter.
Set right my affairs and the affairs of my companions, then the affairs of the Muslims, my Lord.
Lead us, Lord, along the most beneficial path, and be our Companion, O best of companions.
I have trusted in You, O Preserver (Al-Ḥafīẓ), O Withholder of harm (Al-Māniʿ), and I never associate anything with You.
Grant me veils, a sanctuary and a covering that guard against trial, ruin and evil,
a protection through You, through the Qurʾān and through the Messenger of Allah, at all times.
O our Lord, O our Lord, O our Lord, O our Lord, O our Lord, take charge of us.
Take charge of us until we become righteous, reformers, sincere and true counsellors.
I have stood at Your door, O Lord of dignity, hoping for grace through my good opinion (of You).
In You I have taken refuge and (to You) I have fled, and to You I have entrusted my affair: so grant me Your grace.
O You to Whom belong the return and the final destination, O Benign, O Generous, O Helper (An-Naṣīr),
turn my aspiration and my heart toward You, and lead my renown, with us, toward good.
You possess, of generosity and grace, that through which I hope for the fulfilment of my hope.
The soundness of my soul and the soundness of my breast are through You: so set right my whole affair.
Set right all my outward self and what is hidden in me, and purify for me the secret and what is manifest.
Never place between me and You an intermediary other than the one set foremost, the support,
Your beloved, who brings near, the near one, Muḥammad, the best of creation, the wondrous.
O our Lord, pour upon him, with the trustworthy of his Family and his Companions, the best blessing,
through which we gain from You good pleasure and acceptance, and which draws us toward the best of wishes and requests.
